description: Implementation of the D3D11 VertexBuffer class for ANGLE project, managing GPU vertex buffer resources, including initialization, mapping, unmapping, and data storage.

classes.name: VertexBuffer11
classes.description: A class managing a Direct3D 11 vertex buffer resource, providing methods for initialization, data storage, mapping, and unmapping.

methods.name: initialize
methods.description: Initializes the vertex buffer with specified size and usage type.

methods.name: mapResource
methods.description: Maps the vertex buffer resource for writing.

methods.name: hintUnmapResource
methods.description: Unmaps the vertex buffer resource if it is currently mapped.

methods.name: storeVertexAttributes
methods.description: Stores vertex attribute data into the buffer at a specified offset.

methods.name: getBufferSize
methods.description: Returns the size of the buffer.

methods.name: setBufferSize
methods.description: Resizes the buffer if the new size is larger than current.

methods.name: discard
methods.description: Discards the current buffer contents by mapping with write discard.
